The '''Belderone system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Belderone sector/Legends|Belderone sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Belderone/Legends|Belderone]] and [[Kulthis]], and was situated along the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]].<ref name="TEA" />
